environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode). Security group allows inbound 443/80 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional request filtering or inspection layer. ELB performs TLS termination but does not inspect HTTP content. Application runs directly with gunicorn on port 8080.

config.load_balancer: AWS Classic ELB, TCP passthrough on port 443
